title: Google Style Guides (curated offline core)
notes: This package vendors a role-relevant core subset of the upstream Google Style Guide repository rather than pretending to mirror every language artifact.
Each guidance file marked byte_exact=true was recreated in this repository and its Git blob SHA exactly equals the pinned upstream blob SHA.
The local license text preserves the CC BY 3.0 legal text but differs at file-boundary bytes from the upstream blob, so it is deliberately not marked byte-exact.

The upstream repository also contains Java, Python, TypeScript, Shell, HTML/CSS, Objective-C and additional Go guidance. They remain registered upstream material for future expansion; absence from this curated package is not represented as local availability.
Alibaba P3C is kept as a separate Java-focused package because its historical Chinese Java rules and provenance differ from Google's current style guides.
